h1: Custom Recyclable Pens for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom recyclable pens in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Eco-friendly writing instruments with your logo. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom recyclable pens let you promote your brand while reducing environmental impact. Unlike standard promotional pens, these are made from recycled materials or designed for easy recycling at end of life. Options like the Simple Stix™ Recycled Currency Pen use post-consumer waste, while the Bamboozle Comfort Pen offers a natural bamboo barrel. Perfect for trade shows, offices, or sustainability initiatives, these pens accept full-color imprinting and are available in various ink colors.
heroAltText: Custom recyclable pens with company logo, including eco-friendly options like recycled currency and bamboo barrel pens
